name: Aishah Rahman
bio:
Aishah Rahman's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Unlike many of her peers, she wasn't raised around engines or racetracks. Instead, a chance encounter with a Formula 1 documentary ignited a passion that led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, she worked her way through various junior racing series, honing her skills and building a reputation for meticulous data analysis and problem-solving. 

Her approach to race engineering is deeply rooted in collaboration. Aishah believes that the best results come from open communication and shared understanding between the driver, mechanics, and herself. She's known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to quickly identify and address issues during a race. What makes her distinctive is her innate ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights for the driver, fostering a strong sense of trust and confidence.

At Hitech GP, Aishah's commitment to data accuracy and team unity makes her invaluable. Her focus on continuous improvement and her mentoring of junior engineers has contributed significantly to the team's consistent performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Aishah has a warm smile and a focused gaze, projecting an aura of quiet competence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn circuit diagrams.
Has a lucky charm, a small wayang kulit puppet, that she keeps in her toolbox.
Insists on a specific brand of Malaysian coffee before every race.
